body: From the DM-186 review (orchestrator, this run): fix and pin — (F1) `add_ticket` can forge a correction marker (normalize.ts:170 buildTicket; the guard is only in patchTicket): strip marker-prefixed references in add_ticket and let applyCorrections attach markers internally; (F2) selecting only a new experiment for a completed epic creates another follow-up epic even when an open unsaved one exists — reuse it; (F3) pin the vagueness heuristic: these should be vague: 'Improve the quality of the code and the tests in the whole project soon.', 'To be decided after the next sprint review with the whole team present.', 'aaa bbb ccc ddd …'; these should be specific: 'TODO comments in src/core/board/imports.ts are deleted or turned into tickets.', 'Placeholder text of the search input in Search.tsx becomes …'; (F4) a bad/passed/missing sprint target gives a misleading 'restate it in a new report revision' message and missing is conflict not not_found; (F5) kept markers plus a full 100-reference edit can exceed LIMITS.references in the portable schema.
